title: Core: AS2 MovieClip drawing API (beginFill, lineTo, moveTo)
description: Test compilation of MovieClip drawing API: mc.beginFill(color, alpha), mc.beginGradientFill(type, colors, alphas, ratios, matrix), mc.endFill(), mc.lineStyle(thickness, color, alpha), mc.moveTo(x, y), mc.lineTo(x, y), mc.curveTo(cx, cy, ax, ay), mc.drawRect(x,y,w,h) (if exists), mc.clear().
